title: Arizer XQ2 Desktop Multi Purpose Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
We have our own personal XQ2 and its a great desktop
Best non Volcano bag filler we have ever used, highly recommended

The All New Arizer XQ2 is the culmination of 15 years of high quality vaporizer manufacturing. More features, better temperature control, direct flow & bag, improved balloon system, upgraded operating system, multi-color base LEDS.

The next generation to one of the best classic desktop vaporizers of all time, the Extreme Q Vaporizer.

XQ2 Multi Purpose Convection Desktop Vaporizer

Whip Attachment
Enjoy the 3’ Whip attachment for on-demand direct draw, and try using the 3-speed Fan for Assisted Draw. Glass ends for easy cleaning and maintenance, high-quality silicone tubing for smooth vapor delivery, and convenient 360°Swivel Action for easy sharing!

Mini Whip & Collection Bag
Use the convenient balloon system to fill collection bags/balloons with vapor to suit your preferences. Perfect for high volume use, sharing quality vapor with friends, and carrying with you around the home! Plus, customize the bag/balloon size for your needs.

Aromatherapy
Botanicals such as Lavender, Chamomile, Orange Peels, and many more, can be vaporized for aromatherapy using the Glass Aromatherapy Dish. Heat your favorite herbs and flowers to precise temperatures and enjoy the pleasing aromas, terpenes, and botanical compounds to promote and enhance energetic or relaxing environments.

Dynamic Color Leds
LED lights in the unit base and heater can be set to Dynamic Mode, Spectrum Mode, one of 8 individual color options, and can also be turned off. Spectrum Mode changes the color every 2 seconds in a continuous loop. Dynamic mode allows you to tell the state of the unit at a glance:
Heating – Pulses from Yellow to Orange
Reach Set Temperature – Blinks Green twice
Stable Temperature – Pulses orange
Fan Operation – Pulses purple
Cooling – Pulses cyan
Cooling with Fan – Pulses blue

CHOOSE FROM TWO BONUS PACKAGES:
1. 4 PIECE PREMIUM HARDENED ALUMINUM GRINDER
2. 6 EXTRA BALLOONS AND 2 DOME SCREENS

Features:
Multi Purpose Dry Herb Vaporizer
Advanced Ceramic Convection Heater
User-Friendly Operating System
Custom Session Settings
High Quality Borosilicate Glass
Programmable Remote Control
Replacement Air Intake Filter
Quiet 3 Speed Fan
Multi Color Base and Heater LEDs
Upgraded Accessories

Included in the kit:
1 x Arizer XQ2 Vaporizer
1 x Power Adapter Charger
1 x XQ2 Remote Control
1 x Glass Cloud Chamber
1 x Glass Flavor Chamber
2 x Tuff BowlGrips
1 x Glass Aromatherapy Dish
1 x 3” Silicone Whip
1 x Glass Mini Whip Attachment
1 x Glass Balloon Mouthpiece
1 x Balloon Connector
2 x Balloon Bags
1 x Balloon Cap
1 x Airpath Filter Cartridge
1 x Stainless Steel Stir Tool
1 x Dome Screen
1 x Flat Screen
1 x Aromatic Botanicals
1 x Owner’s Manual

Arizer is a Canadian company offering reliable desktop and portable vaporizers.

Warranty Information
